h1: The 6 Best VESA Mini PC Mounts of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best VESA Mini PC Mounts 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six VESA mini PC mounts for behind-monitor, wall and under-desk setups, with device-size limits, weight ratings and budget picks.
summary: The HumanCentric thin client mount is our best overall for a behind-monitor VESA setup. The VIVO steel bracket is the budget pick with a 3-year warranty, the Adjustable Thin Client mount is the most flexible, and the Dell and Lenovo mounts are for owners of those exact micro PCs.
intro: A VESA mount only helps if two numbers line up: the 75x75 or 100x100 mm hole pattern on your monitor, and the thickness of your mini PC. Plenty of buyers get the first right and forget the second, then discover their box is a few millimeters too thick for the bracket's jaws.
We reviewed eight listings and ranked six on how clearly they state device width, weight rating and mounting options. This is a paper comparison drawn from the spec sheets, not a bench trial.

products.name: HumanCentric Thin Client Mount Bracket Mini PC VESA Monitor Arm
products.verdict: The clearest spec sheet and the most hardware in the box.
products.description:
The HumanCentric fits VESA 75x75 and 100x100 mm patterns and accepts devices 0.65 to 2.55 inches deep. It carries an 11 lb device rating, or 18 lb combined with the monitor, and ships with silicone scratch strips plus hardware for wall, under-desk and pole mounting.

It leads the list because it states both a device rating and a combined rating, which is the detail most rivals skip. It costs more than the under-$25 options, but you get a fuller kit.

Buy it for a behind-monitor setup with a mid-size mini PC. The caveat is the 2.55 inch depth limit, so measure first.
products.idealFor: Buyers hanging a mini PC behind a monitor arm.
products.skipIf: Your PC is thicker than 2.55 inches.

products.name: VIVO Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC Mount Bracket, CPU VESA
products.verdict: Powder-coated steel and a 3-year warranty for under $25.
products.description:
The VIVO bracket is solid steel with a powder-coated finish, adjusts from 1.8 to 7.1 cm in width, handles 5 kg (about 11 lb), and fits VESA 75x75 and 100x100 mm. The maker backs it with a 3-year warranty.

It ranks second because it matches the HumanCentric's 11 lb capacity at a lower price, but offers less detail on included extras.

Choose it for a budget behind-monitor install. The caveat is the narrower stated width range than some rivals.
products.idealFor: Budget shoppers who want steel and a warranty.
products.skipIf: You want cable management accessories included.

products.name: Adjustable Thin Client Mini PC VESA Mount to Wall, Under Desk, Monitor Arm
products.verdict: A 12 lb open-frame metal mount with the widest fit range.
products.description:
This open-frame metal mount adjusts from 0.63 to 2.8 inches wide, holds 12 lb, and supports wall, under-desk, behind-monitor and pole mounting. A cable management clip and pen holder come included.

It ranks third because the wider 2.8 inch range and 12 lb rating beat the VIVO on paper, but its listing is less specific about warranty.

It suits buyers who may move the PC later. The caveat is a lesser-known brand name.
products.idealFor: People who might switch between desk and wall.

products.name: VIVO Behind Monitor Mini PC VESA Mount for Dell OptiPlex Micro
products.verdict: Purpose-built for the OptiPlex Micro with a ventilated frame.
products.description:
The VIVO OptiPlex mount is built for Dell OptiPlex Micro machines, with VESA 75x75 and 100x100 mm support, a ventilated open structure, and hardware for wood studs and concrete.

It ranks fourth because it is model-specific, which gives a snug fit for Dell owners but less use for anyone else.

Pick it if you own an OptiPlex Micro. The caveat is that other brands are not the target.
products.idealFor: Dell OptiPlex Micro owners wanting a snug fit.
products.skipIf: Your mini PC is a different brand.

products.name: Mini PC Mount for Dell Micro Mount, Wall VESA and Under Desk Mount
products.verdict: Another OptiPlex Micro fit, with Velcro adapter straps.
products.description:
This mount is for named Dell OptiPlex Micro models and fits a device size of 1.4 by 7 by 7.2 inches. It supports VESA 75x75 and 100x100 mm, wall or under-desk mounting, and includes Velcro straps for the power adapter.

It ranks below the VIVO OptiPlex mount because its listing adds no ventilation detail, though it states the exact device size.

Good for a tidy Dell setup. The caveat is the same model limit.
products.idealFor: Dell Micro owners who also want to hide the power brick.

products.name: Mini PC Mount for Lenovo ThinkCentre Wall VESA and Under Desk Mount
products.verdict: Built around named ThinkCentre Tiny models.
products.description:
This mount is purpose-built for named Lenovo ThinkCentre Tiny models, supports VESA 75x75 and 100x100 mm, and can also be used on a wall or under a desk. It comes with an anti-scratch rubber mat and Velcro adapter straps.

It ranks last only because its audience is narrow, as with the Dell versions.

Buy it if you own a listed ThinkCentre Tiny. The caveat is you must check the model list.
products.skipIf: Your PC is not on the listed models.

whatMatters.detail: VESA is the standard square of four screw holes on the back of a monitor, usually 75x75 or 100x100 mm. If your monitor does not have one of these, the mount cannot attach. Look at the back of your monitor or its spec sheet for the numbers.

A thin-client bracket grips the PC between two jaws, so the box must fall inside the stated width or depth range. Too thick and it will not fit. Measure your PC and compare to the range in the listing.
The rating is the maximum the bracket is built to carry, often 11 or 12 lb. A micro PC and its cables can add up. Look for a combined rating when mounting behind a monitor.
A ventilated open frame lets heat escape, which matters for a PC running all day. A fully boxed mount can trap warmth. Look for words like open-frame or ventilated.
Some brackets support only behind-monitor use, while others also do wall, under-desk and pole. Extra options help if you rearrange. Check the hardware list in the bullet points.

faq.q: Is the HumanCentric worth more than the VIVO?
faq.a: It adds a combined rating, scratch strips and fuller hardware. The VIVO adds a 3-year warranty at a lower price.
Attach the bracket to the PC, then screw it to the monitor's VESA holes or to the wall or desk using the supplied hardware.

faq.a: No. Those mounts are built for named models, so use the universal ones instead.

finalTake: The HumanCentric is the best all-round VESA mini PC mount, with clear ratings and a full kit. The VIVO steel bracket is the budget answer, and the Adjustable Thin Client mount is the flexible one. Measure your PC and monitor holes first.
